items: A feature crate depending on another feature crate, a UI toolkit or lib-database (viper-architecture.md, Dependencies)

lib-documents 6, lib-bills 4, lib-budgets 4, lib-categories 2, lib-payees 2, lib-tags 2
lib-accounts, lib-inventory, lib-institutions and the migrated lib-transactions and lib-units comply
